requirements.evidence: Although R1 is porous, the dry nitrogen flush environment (confirmed in gas_volume.md) provides continuous protection against moisture and contamination. The controlled, dry atmosphere mitigates degradation risks that would affect porous materials in uncontrolled environments.
Recommended thickness of 2 cm falls within the specified 1-6 cm constraint range

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c
requirements.evidence: R1 at 2 cm achieves 4.707 sigma separation, the highest value among all 18 simulations conducted across all three radiators and six thickness values. This represents the best possible separation achievable with the available radiator candidates.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness
requirements.evidence: Final recommendation submitted: Radiator-R1 at 2 cm thickness
